events.change_summary: Full scope definition with implementation phases, requirements, acceptance criteria
Full scope: 7 story variants, interaction tests, all dropdown-menu exports covered

events.rationale: Story creation is straightforward, follows established Storybook patterns from existing stories (button, select, dialog). Single file with 7 variants, no new UI exposed to users, no architectural decisions. Skip architecture and design stages — story structure and component patterns already defined by project conventions.

alternatives_considered: Split into two phases: basic variants + interaction tests
Split by component pattern: items → groups → submenus
events.decision: Single implementation phase covers all story variants
events.rationale: Story creation is self-contained. All 7 variants (Default, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Disabled, Separator+Shortcut, Submenu, KeyboardInteraction) fit into one coherent phase since they're all part of the same file with no dependencies between them.

alternatives_considered: Cover exports by category in separate tasks
events.decision: All 14 dropdown-menu exports must be directly tested or used
events.rationale: Comprehensive coverage prevents gaps in Chromatic baseline and ensures developers have reference patterns for all component APIs. Partial coverage risks regressions in untested exports.

alternatives_considered: Skip keyboard testing, visual regression only
events.decision: Include keyboard interaction play function for accessibility validation
events.rationale: Dropdown is keyboard-navigable by design (Radix UI accessibility). Play function tests Arrow Up/Down, Enter, Escape. Ensures Chromatic baseline captures correct interaction behavior and prevents regressions in keyboard support.
